DISOBEY.definition: Refuse to go along with; refuse to follow; be disobedient.
DISOBEY.example: He disobeyed his supervisor and was fired.

SIDE.gloss: a place within a region identified relative to a center or reference location
SIDE.definition: A place within a region identified relative to a center or reference location.
SIDE.example: They always sat on the right side of the church.

BODY.gloss: the entire physical structure of an organism
BODY.definition: The entire physical structure of an organism (an animal, plant, or human being).
BODY.example: He felt as if his whole body were on fire.

DOSE.gloss: a measured portion of medicine taken at any one time
DOSE.definition: A measured portion of medicine taken at any one time.

BODE.gloss: indicate, as with a sign or an omen
BODE.definition: Indicate, as with a sign or an omen.

YES.example: I was hoping for a yes.

BED.gloss: a piece of furniture that provides a place to sleep
BED.definition: A piece of furniture that provides a place to sleep.
BED.example: He sat on the edge of the bed.

DIE.gloss: pass from physical life and lose all bodily attributes and functions necessary to…
DIE.definition: Pass from physical life and lose all bodily attributes and functions necessary to sustain life.

BID.example: The Swiss dealer offered $2 million for the painting.

BYE.gloss: an automatic advance to the next round in a tournament without playing an opponent
BYE.definition: An automatic advance to the next round in a tournament without playing an opponent.
BYE.example: He had a bye in the first round.

DOE.gloss: mature female of mammals of which the male is called `buck'
DOE.definition: Mature female of mammals of which the male is called `buck'.

SOY.definition: A source of oil; used for forage and soil improvement and as food.
